The old acceptance 'no public.ecr.aws Postgres reference remains in either workflow' is therefore refined below to service/container images.

SCOPE BOUNDARY: this item owns every Postgres image reference (ci.yml sql-execution-evidence, nightly.yml postgres-integration/mirror-postgres17, mirror-ci-images.yml postgres17). Non-Postgres anonymous pulls (QuestDB in the lint job) belong to ci-dockerhub-anonymous-pulls-20261025.

DECISION GATES (stop and ask the owner)
G1 GHCR seeding. The digest must exist in ghcr.io/benchbox-dev/postgres before #3455's CI can pass; the owner seeds it by hand. Do not merge #3455 before the digest is present and pullable by the job token.
G2 If the next nightly's mirror-postgres17 still fails on rate limits after #3449: stop and ask (options: owner re-seeds by hand; add a third same-digest source; authenticate a source). Do not add unbounded retries or unpin to a tag.
G3 GHCR package visibility/permissions for the `packages: read` token are an owner setting.

GUARDRAILS
- Keep the Postgres 17 digest sha256:2d2b8998d31037bf721cfdf764d76ba74171b4fab3431b7f72c27c56ddbdf9e3 unchanged; do not move to PG 16.2 or any other major; do not change gate expectations (same Postgres, same queries).
- No unpinned image tags; no new secrets; keep `packages: read` minimal; no SKIP and no `--no-verify`.
- Do not reopen the embedded-pgserver route (#3382) without an owner decision.
- Do not edit docker/postgresql/docker-compose.yml defaults unless the owner asks.

STANDING GUARDRAILS: work only in a `make worktree-create` worktree after `make agent-write-preflight` (primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only); run tests only through make targets (`make test-fast`, `make pr-preflight`, `make sql-execution-gate`, `make tpcds-obt-equivalence`) or targeted `uv run -- python -m pytest <paths> -n 4`; never BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, `make test-unlock` or raw broad runs; one heavy run at a time; no live-cloud spend and no production publish without explicit owner approval; published result bundles are never edited (only manifest-sidecar `known_defects` and results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md); no SKIP / --no-verify / `git add -A`; no explanatory comments or docstrings in code (`make comment-policy-check`); uv only; identity Joe Harris, no Co-Authored-By; PR flow `make pr-preflight` once, `make pr-open`, CI + oracle review, `make pr-arm`.
